summary: Customer reports unauthorized charge; agent freezes card, files dispute.

intents.keywords: I got a bill ... what's going on?
issues: Potential fraudulent use of credit card
actions of agent: Initiated credit freeze on the card
Filed a dispute for the unauthorized charge
Promised to provide updates on the dispute status
intents.resolution: Credit card frozen and dispute filed.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent responded quickly and professionally.

issues: Customer wants to know when they will get their money back after reporting an unauthorized charge.
actions of agent: Provided an estimated refund timeline of 5 to 7 days.
Promised to keep the customer updated on the progress of the refund.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent provided a clear timeline and offered to keep the customer updated.
